title: 😳 पीहू ने बारह लाइनें जोड़ीं, पर आठवीं लाइन पर शब्द उलझ गए... #kids #kahani
title_alts: 🤔 क्या पीहू की सबसे लंबी कविता चार बच्चों की ताली पा सकेगी? #kids #kahani
😊 पीहू की लंबी पट्टी और अटकी हुई आठवीं लाइन... अब कमरे में क्या होगा? #kids #kahani
refrain: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
description_hook: पीहू चाहती थी कि उसकी कविता सबसे लंबी हो। बारह लाइनें लिखना आसान था, याद रखना नहीं।

characters.name: पीहू
characters.description: six years old, short bob with a red hairclip, orange frock, a smudge of pencil on one cheek

scenes.narration: पीहू की कविता सबसे लंबी होनी थी, वरना ताली नहीं मिलती। कमरे में चार बच्चे बैठे।
scenes.caption: Peehu's poem had to be the longest, or no one clapped. Four children sat down.
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, stands in a small room holding a long strip of paper covered in handwritten lines. Four children sit cross-legged on a mat in front of her with their hands in their laps. Soft daylight through a window, a ceiling fan and a cot behind them, eager mood.

scenes.narration: पीहू ने पट्टी पर बारह लाइनें लिखीं। आठवीं पर शब्द उलझे। तुम भी गिनो, आठ या नौ?
scenes.caption: Peehu had written twelve lines. The eighth tangled. Count with her: eight or nine?
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, reads from the long paper strip held at arm's length in the small room, her lips pursed in the middle of a word. Two of the four seated children hold up fingers to count, the other two fidget with the mat. Daylight from the window, the fan turning above.

scenes.narration: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: One tap, one line, then on we go!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, taps her own knee with two fingers while chanting, the long paper strip tucked under one arm, standing in the small room. The four children watch her tapping hand. Bright daylight from the window.

scenes.narration: दो बच्चे उठकर बाहर चल दिए। पीहू फिर उसी लाइन पर अटकी।
scenes.caption: Two children got up and walked outside. Peehu stuck on the same line again.
scenes.image_brief: In the small room two children walk out through the doorway with their backs turned, while Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, stands with the long paper strip drooping from one hand and her mouth half open. The two children still on the mat look at the floor. Flat daylight, the window pale.

scenes.narration: पीहू ने पट्टी चार टुकड़ों में फाड़ी। हर बच्चे को एक टुकड़ा। बोली, “एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!”
scenes.caption: Peehu tore the strip into four pieces and handed one to each child.
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, holds four short torn pieces of the paper strip fanned out in one hand in the small room and passes one to each of the two children on the mat. Two empty places on the mat beside them. Daylight from the window, lively mood.

scenes.narration: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: One tap, one line, then on we go!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, taps her knee in time in the small room while the two children hold their torn paper pieces and tap their knees the same way. Daylight from the window, warm mood.

scenes.narration: बाहर गए बच्चे लौट आए। चारों ने बारी बारी लाइन कही। तुम भी जोड़ो!
scenes.caption: The two who left came back. All four said a line in turn. Add yours too!
scenes.image_brief: Four children sit in a circle on the mat in the small room, each holding a short torn paper piece, one of them speaking with a hand raised while the others tap their knees. Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, kneels in the circle listening. Soft late daylight from the window, calm mood.

scenes.narration: पीहू को छोटी कविता बड़ी लगी। एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: Peehu's short poem felt bigger than the long one. One tap, one line, then on!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, sits back on her heels in the small room with shining eyes and her torn paper piece pressed to her chest, the four children around her tapping their knees together. Warm late daylight from the window, contented mood.

title: 😬 सोहम ने रिबन वाली घंटी हिलाई, पर छोटी बहन ने उसे खींच लिया... #kids #rhyme
title_alts: 🤔 क्या सोहम की साइकिल गमले से टकराने के बाद दुकान तक पहुँचेगी? #kids #rhyme
💛 सोहम की घंटी और छोटी बहन की ज़िद... गमला चटका, अब खेल का क्या? #kids #rhyme
refrain: टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!
description_hook: सोहम का खेल एक ही था, हर मोड़ पर घंटी। पीछे बैठी छोटी बहन को वही घंटी चाहिए थी।

characters.name: सोहम
characters.description: seven years old, short spiky hair, blue striped t-shirt, brown sandals, a scab on one knee

scenes.narration: घंटी बजाते सोहम को दुकान तक जाना था, वरना खेल ख़त्म। छोटी बहन पीछे बैठी थी।
scenes.caption: Sohum had to reach the shop ringing the bell, or the game was over.
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, sits on a small bicycle at the mouth of a narrow lane with a brass bell tied to the handlebar with a red ribbon. His four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails sits on the carrier behind him holding his shirt. Morning light between low houses, a shop shutter far down the lane, eager mood.

scenes.narration: सोहम ने रिबन वाली घंटी हिलाई। तुम भी बोलो, टन टन! बहन ने भी घंटी माँगी।
scenes.caption: Sohum shook the ribboned bell. Say it too: ting ting! His sister wanted it as well.
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, rides slowly down the narrow lane shaking the brass bell on its red ribbon with one hand, mouth open in a chant, while his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails reaches forward over his shoulder towards the bell. Morning light, house walls close on both sides.

scenes.narration: टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!
scenes.caption: Ting ting, two bells, the road is clear!
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, rings the brass bell twice with his thumb in the narrow lane, chin up and mouth open in a chant, his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails laughing behind him. Two hens step aside ahead of the wheel. Clear morning light.

scenes.narration: बहन ने घंटी खींची, हैंडल घूमा। साइकिल गमले से टकराई। गमला चटका, रिबन खुला।
scenes.caption: His sister pulled the bell and the handlebar turned. The cycle hit a flower pot.
scenes.image_brief: In the narrow lane the small bicycle has stopped against a clay flower pot beside a doorstep, a crack running down the pot, the red ribbon hanging loose from the handlebar. Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, holds the tilted bicycle upright with both feet on the ground while his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails clutches the brass bell. Flat morning light, dust in the air.

scenes.narration: सोहम ने घंटी बहन की मुट्ठी में रखी। बोला, “घंटी तुम्हारी, चलाना मेरा। टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!”
scenes.caption: Sohum put the bell in his sister's fist: yours to ring, mine to pedal.
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, closes his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails's small fist around the brass bell in the narrow lane, both of them beside the cracked clay pot, the bicycle leaning on his hip. Morning light, a kind older woman watching from a doorway.

scenes.narration: टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!
scenes.caption: Ting ting, two bells, the road is clear!
scenes.image_brief: His four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails holds the brass bell high and rings it, mouth open in a chant, sitting on the carrier of the small bicycle while Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, pedals slowly down the narrow lane. Bright morning light between the houses.

scenes.narration: साइकिल फिर धीरे चली। हर मोड़ पर बहन की घंटी बजी।
scenes.caption: The cycle rolled on slowly. At every turn his sister's bell rang.
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, pedals the small bicycle around a corner of the narrow lane with both hands on the handlebar, his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails ringing the brass bell behind him. Warm light on one wall, shade on the other, easy mood.

scenes.narration: दुकान पास आ गई। साथ में गिनो, एक दो!
scenes.caption: The shop came close. Count along with them: one, two!
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, and his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails on the small bicycle a few steps from the shop shutter at the end of the narrow lane, the shopkeeper stacking biscuit tins outside. The brass bell is in the little girl's hand. Warm morning light, happy mood.

scenes.narration: सोहम को यह आवाज़ अच्छी लगी। टन टन, दो घंटी, रास्ता खाली!
scenes.caption: Sohum liked this sound better than before. Ting ting, two bells, road clear!
scenes.image_brief: Sohum, a seven-year-old boy with short spiky hair, a blue striped t-shirt and brown sandals, stands astride the small bicycle outside the shop smiling with his head turned back to his four-year-old sister in a pink frock with two tiny pigtails, who is ringing the brass bell with both hands. Warm morning light down the narrow lane, contented mood.
